Routing lessons:
- For large east-region claim requests, choose C (regional office). Confirmed accepted on REQ-2404, REQ-2405, REQ-2407, and REQ-2409.
- Do not choose C for large east-region invoice or refund requests; rejected on REQ-2400–2403, REQ-2406, and REQ-2408.
- Invoice/refund requests must instead use A (standard queue) or B (priority desk); available evidence does not yet establish which one.
- Sender department, name, and message wording did not override the request-type pattern.

Routing lessons:
- For large east-region claim requests, choose C (regional office). Confirmed accepted on REQ-2404, REQ-2405, REQ-2407, REQ-2409, and REQ-2413.
- For large east-region invoice requests, choose B (priority desk). Confirmed accepted on REQ-2411, REQ-2416, and REQ-2419; A was rejected on REQ-2410, REQ-2412, and REQ-2415.
- For large east-region refund requests, choose A (standard queue). Confirmed accepted on REQ-2418; B was rejected on REQ-2414.
- Large east-region shipment requests are not routed to C; C was rejected on REQ-2417. The correct option remains unknown.
- Request type and region determine routing in the observed cases. Sender department, sender name, urgency, wording, and submission details did not override the pattern.

Routing lessons:
- For large east-region claim requests, choose C (regional office). Confirmed accepted on REQ-2404, REQ-2405, REQ-2407, REQ-2409, REQ-2413, and REQ-2426.
- For large east-region invoice requests, choose B (priority desk). Confirmed accepted on REQ-2411, REQ-2416, REQ-2419, REQ-2425, REQ-2427, and REQ-2429; A was rejected on REQ-2410, REQ-2412, and REQ-2415.
- For large east-region refund requests, choose A (standard queue). Confirmed accepted on REQ-2418, REQ-2420, REQ-2423, and REQ-2428; B was rejected on REQ-2414.
- Large east-region shipment routing remains unknown. C was rejected on REQ-2417. D is invalid, as shown by REQ-2421, REQ-2422, and REQ-2424. Test only valid options A, B, or C next.
- Observed routing is determined by request type and region. Sender department/name, urgency, wording, and submission details have not overridden the pattern.

Routing lessons:
- For large east-region claim requests, choose C (regional office). Confirmed accepted on REQ-2404, REQ-2405, REQ-2407, REQ-2409, REQ-2413, REQ-2426, and REQ-2430.
- For large east-region invoice requests, choose B (priority desk). Confirmed accepted on REQ-2411, REQ-2416, REQ-2419, REQ-2425, REQ-2427, REQ-2429, REQ-2433, REQ-2434, REQ-2435, and REQ-2439. A was rejected on REQ-2410, REQ-2412, and REQ-2415.
- For large east-region refund requests, choose A (standard queue). Confirmed accepted on REQ-2418, REQ-2420, REQ-2423, REQ-2428, and REQ-2437; B was rejected on REQ-2414.
- Large east-region shipment routing remains unresolved. A was rejected on REQ-2432, REQ-2436, and REQ-2438; B was rejected on REQ-2431; C was rejected on REQ-2417. D is invalid (REQ-2421, REQ-2422, REQ-2424). No valid option has yet been identified; do not assume A, B, or C without new evidence.
- Routing appears determined by request type and region. Sender department/name, urgency, wording, and submission details have not overridden the pattern.

Routing lessons:
- For large east-region claim requests, C (regional office) is usually correct: accepted on REQ-2404, 2405, 2407, 2409, 2413, 2426, 2430, and 2440. However, C was rejected on REQ-2447, so treat this as a strong pattern, not an absolute rule.
- For large east-region invoice requests, choose B (priority desk). Accepted on REQ-2411, 2416, 2419, 2425, 2427, 2429, 2433, 2434, 2435, 2439, 2442, 2443, and 2444. A was rejected on REQ-2410, 2412, and 2415.
- For large east-region refund requests, choose A (standard queue). Accepted on REQ-2418, 2420, 2423, 2428, 2437, 2441, 2445, 2446, and 2449. B was rejected on REQ-2414.
- Large east-region shipment routing remains unresolved. A was rejected on REQ-2432, 2436, 2438, and 2448; B was rejected on REQ-2431; C was rejected on REQ-2417; D is invalid (REQ-2421, 2422, 2424). Do not assume A, B, or C without new evidence.
- Routing strongly tracks request type and region, but exceptions now exist (claim REQ-2447). Sender, department, urgency, wording, submission channel, and paperwork format have not reliably overridden the type/region pattern.

Routing lessons:
- For large east-region invoice requests, choose B (priority desk). Repeatedly accepted, including REQ-2456. A was rejected on REQ-2410, 2412, and 2415.
- For large east-region refund requests, choose A (standard queue). Reconfirmed by REQ-2451, 2452, 2453, 2455, and 2459; also accepted on REQ-2418, 2420, 2423, 2428, 2437, 2441, 2445, 2446, and 2449. B was rejected on REQ-2414.
- Large east-region claim routing is not reliably C. C was accepted many times previously but rejected on REQ-2447, 2450, and 2458. Treat the prior C pattern as unreliable; no alternative has yet been confirmed.
- Large east-region shipment routing remains uncertain. C was accepted on REQ-2454, but B was rejected on REQ-2457; earlier A was rejected on REQ-2432, 2436, 2438, and 2448, B on REQ-2431, C on REQ-2417, and D was invalid on REQ-2421, 2422, and 2424. C is now the only option with a recent positive result, but do not treat it as certain.
- Routing generally tracks request type and region. Sender, department, urgency, wording, submission channel, and paperwork format have not yet shown a reliable override; scanned paperwork and urgency did not change refund/invoice outcomes.
